notes.title: 23UL is now opensource !
notes.content:
23UL is now open source ! github.com/mxslam/23UL 


To open the file project :

1. Download and install Gdevelop 5 https://gdevelop-app.com/

2. Open 23UL.json with Gdevelop

3. Enjoy !
